about: Reference recordings of wild turkey (Meleagris gallopavo). Licenses were checked on each recording's own page. trimStartSec/trimEndSec are seconds in the original file as downloaded. Each clip keeps at least 0.3 s before the call for the noise floor.

clips.author: Jonathon Jongsma
clips.modifications: Trimmed; decoded from MP3 and converted to mono 44.1 kHz 16-bit WAV. No filtering or gain change.
clips.notes: Classified as gobble by measurement: a single ~0.95 s burst of rapid broadband pulses, energy peak about 1.4-3 kHz, far louder than anything else (40-60 dB above the noise floor); xeno-canto type 'song', sex 'male', remarks say 'gobbling'. Male seen <10 m away (recordist remarks). Clean, close bird. Followed 1.4 s later by the 'click' the recordist mentions; the click is outside the trim. Peak sample 0.56 of full scale (not clipped).
